name: The Hoargate
description: The Crown's garrison across the narrows north of Silverfall. Weight 0: the master plan pins it (the authored-sites law) to the one place the mountain leaves open. Nine bodies, two braziers, three boards, and no opinion at all about whether you should keep walking.

signs.title: THE HOARGATE
lines: that is a fact, not a blessing
